posts.title: Comments Flood OMB Proposal
posts.description: Comments Flood OMB Proposal to Cement Political Control of Grants Among other changes, the proposal from the Office of Management and Budget says political appointees, not peer reviewers, would be the primary deciders of who gets grants, and says officials could yank funding even after it’s awarded and research or another project has begun. posts.title: Fight for the Internet
posts.description: Christine Lemmer-Webber: What happened to the fight for the Internet? Net neutrality, SOPA... these battles for internet freedom had massive buy-in across the internet. 2012's Wikipedia blackout was especially memorable. posts.title: Resist and Unsubscribe
posts.description: I'm not sure where I first heard about Scott Galloway's Resist and Unsubscribe campaign but it has gotten some media attention . Today I've unsubscribed from: Netflix Youtube TV Youtube Premium Spotify I think that covers all of the ways I was giving money directly to Big Tech.
